name: A CoA-class character missing its racial gets it back when progression synchronizes (#4971, #3952)
contract: Racial abilities are granted at creation for free and are not purchased progression. Characters created before a class's racial variant was mapped are missing it, so SynchronizeProgression (run at login and on level change) must restore the race's racial spells even with the shipped CoA.AutoProgression = 0. The fixture removes the Orc Barbarian's Blood Fury 814283 and raises the level through native GiveLevel.

steps.label: Blood Fury is granted at creation
Remove Blood Fury as an older character lacks it
